chapter: Kid Rena, the Cadillac and Jones's sons
title: Taking up drums before his stroke
summary: Jones learned drums by watching drummers, played one job, then suffered a stroke.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Played one job then I got the stroke. I got my sticks and everything. I got the avenue in my thing. I got everything. I was ready.
Yeah my harness. I was ready to go. And then I got the stroke. I got the snare drum right in there. Mmhmm. I had my own snare drum.
You just took it up late in life then huh? Just took it up. Well that's a shame they could use some good drummers.

I knew drum was good so I took the drum up. You know what I mean just started practicing. But who taught you? Andy? Well drum? No. I just watched drummers and I would learn how to roll. That's the transfer thing because I had those red licks you know. Drum licks you know. But I couldn't roll good. Yeah.
